newsitem.title: USA: Heartport wins FDA okay for catheter.
newsitem.headline: Heartport wins FDA okay for catheter.

text.p: Heartport Inc on Monday said the the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved the company's newest Endoaortic Clamp catheter.

The product is an important component of Heartport's proprietary Endovascular Cardiopulmonary Bypass system. It is being introduced this week at the 77th Annual Meeting of the American Association for Thoracic Surgery in Washington, D.C.
The new catheter, which is more flexible than the previous model, uses a smaller guide wire. It was developed to ease the placement of the bypass sytem on a patient.
